There are two presentations. One right after selecting your topic (project proposal) and one at the end (final presentation+project demo). Show weekly updates and convince maam that you worked (this is a must for a good grade and must be done through weekly updates and presentations). The difficulty of the project depends on the topic that you select, maam won't force you to do a difficult project. Finally, you need to submit a project report (ieee template). Overall, she is one of the best for 299.
